## Bhuta (CR 6)

**XP** 2,400  
 NE Medium undead  
 **Init** +6; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +16  
 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 20, touch 13, flat-footed 17 (+1 dodge, +2 Dex, +7 natural)  
 **hp** 99 (9d8+18 plus 9)  
 **Fort** +5; **Ref** +5; **Will** +9  
 **Defensive Abilities** channel resistance +2; **Immune** undead traits  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** 2 claws +12 (1d8+5 plus grab)  
 **Special Attacks** death grip  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 20, **Dex** 14, Con—, **Int** 12, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 14  
 **Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +11 (+15 grapple); **CMD** 24  
 **Feats** Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Perception), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Weapon Focus (claw), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
 **Skills** Climb +17, Escape Artist +11, Intimidate +14, Knowledge (religion) +6, Perception +16, Stealth +14  
 **Languages** Common  
 **SQ** find target, gentle repose  
 

**Special Abilities**

 
 **Death Grip (Ex)** A bhuta deals 1d8+5 points of damage with a successful grapple check each round the hold is maintained. Because it seizes its victim by the throat, a creature in its grasp cannot speak or cast spells with verbal components.  
 
 **Find Target (Sp)** So long as the bhuta and its killer are on the same plane of existence, it can find its target unerringly as though guided by discern location (caster level 9th).  
 
 **Gentle Repose (Ex)** When it first rises from the dead, a bhuta is preserved as if by gentle repose for a period of 14 days. After that time, its body begins to decay and it takes on an appearance similar to that of a ghoul or zombie.  
 


**Ecology**

 
**Environment** any land or underground  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** none
